# Summit X Icon Private Collection

> Luxury alpine travel brand. A sub-brand of Icon Private Collection.

Summit by Icon Private Collection curates exclusive alpine experiences for discerning travellers — private chalets, heli-ski programmes, guided expeditions, and boutique mountain lodges. Every property and programme is personally selected and arranged by our team. Operating for over 14 years, Summit by Icon Private Collection serves a high-net-worth clientele seeking genuine insider access to the world's finest mountain environments.

## What we offer

- **Alpine chalets** — private luxury chalets in premier ski and mountain destinations, from intimate bolt-holes to grand multi-chalet estates. Each listing includes bedroom count, guest capacity, altitude, amenities, and price band where available.
- **Heli-ski programmes** — exclusive helicopter skiing in remote terrain, arranged with certified guides and full logistical support. Listings include terrain type, group size, season window, and physical requirements.
- **Expeditions** — guided alpine and mountain expeditions combining adventure with exceptional accommodation. Listings include duration, season, terrain, and physical grading.
- **Mountain lodges** — boutique lodges positioned at altitude, combining comfort with access to wilderness. Listings include style, capacity, and signature experiences.
- **Destinations** — curated destination guides for the world's finest alpine locations, including FAQs specific to each destination.

## Content structure

Each chalet, expedition, lodge, and heli-ski page includes:
- Structured data (Schema.org JSON-LD) for machine-readable property details
- Plain-text specification blocks: bedroom count, guest capacity, altitude, terrain, season dates, physical requirements
- FAQ sections with destination-specific questions and answers
- Gallery imagery with descriptive context

## The Edit

The Edit is the Summit by Icon Private Collection journal: editorial coverage of alpine culture, destination guides, property spotlights, and travel intelligence for mountain enthusiasts.

## Enquiries

All programmes are bespoke. Some properties publish a price band; all can be booked on a price-on-request basis. To enquire:
